Question: FIRST OF ALL I DID NOT KNEW THAT MASTURBATION BREAKS FASTS.I MASTURBATED DURING RAMZAN FASTS AND THEN I CAME TO KNOW THAT IT BREAKS RAMZAN FASTS.AFTER KNOWING THAT,I THOUGHT MY FASTS IS ALREADY BROKEN DUE TO MASTURBATION .I DRANK WATER DURING THAT FAST. NOW DO I HAVE TO KEEP ONLY QADA ROZA OR GIVE KAFFARAH ALSO. Answer ID: 26368 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1611/1157/L=1431) Only the qaza of that fast is wajib not kaffarah. Note that masturbation is haram; hence, it is necessary to do tauba and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
